intent: Remove the last stale test name from shell-tests.yml's explicit lists, which was turning the pre-push gate red after the system-maintenance extraction.
scope: .github/workflows/shell-tests.yml - one entry removed from the side-effect-free list
Non-goal: the glob-discovered lib/tests suites, which need no maintenance
changes: Dropped test_usage_monitoring_installer_efficiency.sh from the side-effect-free list. It moved to the system-maintenance repo, and I had already cleaned three names from the Arch-specific list but missed this second list in the same file.

verification.evidence: Before: 'ci-mirror: FAILED - shell test failed: test_usage_monitoring_installer_efficiency.sh', which is what had been rejecting the push. Re-run after the fix to confirm green.

verification.command: cross-check every test named in the workflow against the filesystem
verification.evidence: Extracted every test_*.sh mention and confirmed each file exists under linux_configuration/tests/; no misses remain.

risks: shell-tests.yml keeps two hand-maintained lists plus a glob. A future extraction has to check all three; the cross-check loop used here is the cheap way to catch it.
rollback: git revert; CI would go red again on the missing file, which is how the problem surfaced in the first place.
